summary: Master pension fund credit risk. Learn IFRS 9 ECL modeling, counterparty risk, and private credit strategies. Enroll for expert-led professional training.
lede: Pension fund credit risk management helps trustees, risk managers and investment professionals assess and manage potential losses from counterparties across investment portfolios. This course develops practical skills in estimating default and recovery risk, analyzing private debt, and assessing counterparty exposure in derivatives. Participants also practice credit stress testing, impairment modeling, ESG-integrated assessment, and designing risk policies and reports for investment oversight.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the fiduciary oversight and technical management of pension fund assets.
modules: Pension Credit Risk and ALM Foundations
IFRS 9 and Expected Credit Loss Modeling
Private Credit and Illiquid Debt Analysis
ESG Integration and Modern Credit Pressures
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of fixed-income securities and financial statement analysis. Familiarity with Excel for financial modeling is required. No prior experience with IFRS 9 is necessary, though it is beneficial.
